scopeVerification.question: Is the 510-row register OCADE-only, or does it include the other three bundled products?
scopeVerification.answer: OCADE-only. Verified by three independent probes, not assumed.

probe1_foreignRequirements.detail: No requirement in the register belongs to the workforce, dashboard or document products.

reviewedExceptions.why: Subject is the single word 'resume'. Its area is 'Copilot and Cowork Orchestration; Reliability No-Progress Detection and Long Tasks' and its evidence is copilot-session-flow and work-orchestrator: it means resuming a PAUSED TASK, not a CV. In scope for OCADE.

probe1_foreignRequirements.note: Exceptions are listed by name with a reason rather than hidden by narrowing the pattern, so the judgement can be checked.

probe2_borrowedEvidence.detail: No OCADE requirement cites a test file belonging to another product.

probe3_areaOwnership.note: Every area is an OCADE domain. There is no workforce, news, timesheet or resume area in the register.

sharedInfrastructureCaveat.what: These requirements are OCADE's, but their evidence rests on infrastructure serving all four products.

migrations.note: Only 7 of 32 migrations touch OCADE tables. Database and staging requirements are graded against a set that is mostly other products' work.

sharedInfrastructureCaveat.db01Reclassification: DB-01 (public.ficia_time_entries referenced but never created) is a WORKFORCE product defect. It breaks platform-wide rebuild-from-scratch and remains real, but it is not an OCADE defect and should not be reported as blocking OCADE.

readiness.note: Both figures are weighted ladder positions, not 'percent of features working'. Only rows at REAL TARGET RUNTIME VERIFIED are proven on real equipment.
